entries.zh: 收拢、聚在一处放置；收存、搁起
entries.en: to put (things) together; to lay by, to put away, to store up
entries.notes: 戢(chip)与 juntamente（一并）语义略偏，取「聚而收之」以通两栏。

entries.zh: 一物叠于另一物之上；堆叠、累放
entries.en: to place one on top of another; to stack, to pile up

entries.zh: 佩挂、系带在身上（衣物、饰物）
entries.en: to hang or wear (something) on oneself; to put on (a sash, ornament)
entries.notes: 帶(tōa)训佩系合 L；M 栏后半音写漫漶不可读，故降等。

entries.zh: 托人代求、请人居间说项
entries.en: to put (someone) forward as an intercessor; to entreat through a go-between
entries.notes: H「記」与 intercessor 义不合，疑为「寄／託」之讹；M 栏残缺难读。

entries.zh: 热敷、以热布熨贴（腹部或患处）
entries.en: to apply hot cloths (to the stomach or another part); to foment
entries.notes: 「熨」合 paños calientes，惟 M 栏「tio」不能与熨字直接对应。

entries.en: to knead, to rub, to press with the hand
entries.notes: 此行西语「poner essa casa en la planta…」文义与「揉」不合，M 栏亦多漫漶，仅存字面义。

entries.en: to submerge, to immerse; (perh.) to steep
entries.notes: 西语「a dos fueras, o pares」难通，仅据「潛(chīam/īm)」定浸没一义。

entries.en: to set wine on the table with both hands; to pour out wine
entries.notes: 「酌」合奉酒之训；M 栏后半为西语夹杂之旁注，义不明。

entries.en: to set upright, to place erect
entries.notes: 「en hiesto」即 enhiesto（竖立）；H 栏「戢/接」与竖立义不合，存疑。

entries.zh: 箕踞（盘腿架腿而坐，失礼之坐姿）
entries.en: to sit with the legs crossed or sprawled (a disrespectful posture)
entries.notes: L 作「腿架于股上」，与箕踞（伸足而坐）微异，合观皆指失礼坐姿。

entries.zh: 垫在底下使平稳（支垫、垫稳）
entries.en: to put (something) underneath so that it sits steady; to shim, to prop
entries.notes: H 栏「亏/方」有疑，M 栏 quēñ/quioñ 未详。

entries.en: to hang up, to suspend
entries.notes: 「掛(cūa)」为悬挂，L 作 asentando（安放），二义微有出入。

entries.zh: 以环带束于头上；戴冠、簪戴首饰
entries.en: to put a band or crown on the head; to hoop, to wreathe

entries.zh: 命名、取名（称名、表而出之）
entries.en: to give a name, to name
entries.notes: 「表」须转一义方通；M 栏 mîa（名）可证命名之说。

entries.en: sunset; at the setting of the sun
late afternoon, dusk (the hour of declining sun)
to pile stone upon stone; to build up a heap
to put something on top so that the wind cannot get at it; to cover over
entries.notes: H 栏「遏/過」有疑，M 栏 ar 未详；义据 L「no [le] dé el aire」推。

entries.zh: 放下、安放；（若 apuesto 作赌注解）下注
entries.en: to put down, to place; (if apuesto = wager) to stake a bet
entries.notes: 「apuesto」可读为赌注，亦疑为 aprieto 之讹。

entries.en: to put money into a joint venture; to contribute money to a partnership
to pool capital; to join capital in partnership
to ship the rudder; to put the helm in place

entries.zh: 架腿（一腿搁在另一腿上）
entries.en: to cross the legs; to throw one leg over the other's thigh
entries.notes: M 栏「ã toñ」未详，义据「拋脚后股」与 L 定。
